Dear Falks and Ruth, Here are some more pictures in the series that I last sent you. At the New Guinea Base, all structures are located on two sides of a huge bay and these pictures were taken while we went across from one side to another. The ferry was on a Navy landing craft. Some natives "hitched" a ride on the craft to the other side and we caught some pictures of them. The other pictures in this series were taken of native villages that were passed on the trip across the bay. Then there is a series of shots of 2 Jap prisoners that were caught wandering around on the islands. All they wanted was some food. Note the picture of the fellow who rounded them up. And to Peterson & Appell (I sent you pictures I had taken with them) in the background. I can't tell you too much about these pictures due to censorship but I think you will like them. These Japs were true negroes. Jack.
